title: Kubernetes flashcards: for the KCNA exam
description: Kubernetes and cloud native as flashcards for the Kubernetes and Cloud Native Associate (KCNA) exam: containers, the cluster's architecture, workloads, networking, security, storage, delivery and observability, each idea taught before it is tested.

glossary.AAAA: a DNS record holding an IPv6 address
glossary.CNAME: canonical name: a DNS record that makes one name an alias for another
glossary.GET: the HTTP method for fetching a resource
glossary.HOME: the environment variable holding your home directory
glossary.KCNA: Kubernetes and Cloud Native Associate, the exam this deck prepares for
glossary.KILL: the KILL signal, which stops a process at once
glossary.SSL: Secure Sockets Layer, the older name for TLS
glossary.TERM: the TERM signal, which asks a process to stop

changelog.notes: First draft, not yet released: awaiting the independent audit, a newcomer read-through and an expert review.

checks.what: Two independent audits read all 1161 cards against the Kubernetes documentation and the other cited sources, for accuracy and for plain language
checks.result: They found no card wrong. 23 unsupported claims, 5 ambiguous cards, 41 unclear ones and 119 minor issues were fixed; dead links were replaced, and 4 cards that no published source supports were removed.
